title: We plan the trips we'd want to take
intro: Journey Boom began with a simple idea: holidays should feel effortless for the traveller, however much work goes on behind the scenes.

heroImage.alt: A green valley and river in Pahalgam under dramatic clouds

blocks.text: We're a team of travel planners who have spent years exploring the places we send you to — from the houseboats of Srinagar to the souks of Dubai. That first-hand knowledge shapes every itinerary we write: realistic driving times, hotels we've stayed in ourselves, and the small moments that turn a good trip into a great one.

Whether it's a family holiday, a honeymoon or a solo adventure, we start by listening. Then we design a journey around how you like to travel, and stay with you — on WhatsApp, by phone, at any hour — until you're back home.

items: Transparent, all-inclusive quotes with no hidden charges
Handpicked hotels, houseboats and resorts we know personally
Private, experienced drivers and licensed local guides
24/7 support from a real person throughout your trip

blocks.text: We specialise in Kashmir, Goa and Dubai, and plan tailor-made trips across India and to popular international destinations. If you have somewhere in mind that isn't listed, just ask — chances are we can help.

seo.title: About Us — Handcrafted Holidays
seo.description: Meet Journey Boom: travel planners crafting thoughtful holidays to Kashmir, Goa, Dubai and beyond, with honest pricing and 24/7 support.
